The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Triggers via transaction.on_commit(lambda: task.delay(...)), never directly inside the transaction
- Imports the task at module level with a _task alias and the service inside the task body to avoid circular imports
- Explains the failure it prevents: the worker reading uncommitted data

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
